why: First build round for slice 2 of docs/plan/quests/tea-msg-tag-PLAN.md. (a) The tea patch: demlik's tea built at its 0.27.0 release commit reproduces the published 0.27.0 dist byte for byte, so demlik pull 966's source change was applied to that commit (100 product files; two conflicts with later upstream fixes, resolved to 0.27.0's code under 966's key), built, its hashed chunk names mapped back to 0.27.0's by following the imports from the entry files, and written with pnpm patch and pnpm patch-commit: 584 changed lines in 57 dist files, source maps left alone. It differs from the old patch in 296 lines where 966 also renames tea's semantic events, its internal unions (an engine's phase, saveStatus, the extension envelope, the durable-effects log) and JSDoc text, and changes the Sub id hash input to { _tag, deps }; and in 2 error-message lines where the old patch said 'Sub _tag' and 966 keeps 'Sub type'. K1, K2, K2b, K2c and K3 pass on it. step-commit refuses the patch and the lockfile from a build (exam paths), so both stay uncommitted in the checkout for the lead. (b) Our side: 966's rename script, adapted in the scratchpad (the patched dist read as an oracle for tea's own keys, a keep list for our formats, exam files never edited), renamed 480 lines in 66 product files; the hand pass then made every Msg, Cmd and Sub schema a TaggedUnion or TaggedStruct, wrote values with makers, used Types.ExtractTag, and fixed what the checker could not see (Program and the app's name readers, the pressed Msg's name, Execution's answers, the counter window, Chunk letters), 1675 changed lines in 69 files, plus 10 docs files. 36 inline no-hand-tag ignores, each with its reason. Mail.Reply is flat, one Msg per reply kind, detected with Schema.is(Mail.Reply). The product type-checks and runs the same laws on the old patch and the new one. Laws left red are test-file faults the review should send to tests: 10 laws red at run time and 16 test files with type errors, listed in the build report.
note: Ran at the pushed head's code with the 966 patch installed: vitest on the 64 unit law files the branch changed (558 tests, 6 fail, all test faults), the 14 unit files beside changed product files plus Send.types.test.ts (75 tests, 2 fail, test faults), and 50 integration files the changed files reach (697 tests ran; Runner.integration.test.ts fails at collection and chaos.laws.integration.test.ts fails one law, both test faults; instance-wire.integration.test.ts fails one law because ssh-keygen is absent in this box). The same 64 unit files on the old patch gave the same 6 failures. --changed origin/main is refused by the test config here, since the lockfile changed. pnpm format, pnpm lint (17 parts) and the ratchet pass; one pnpm typecheck fails on test files only (67 errors in 14 libfabrika test files, more in inbox's RunnerTest.ts and tezgah's program.laws.test.ts); loosening.sh: 0 hits. No visual or workerd test ran on purpose.
